rationale: Price is at 91.4% of today's range and within 0.21% of the session high, with the last candle showing a small pullback (close at 94.20 vs open at 94.27) and declining volume on recent bars — momentum is stalling near resistance. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.81%, VIXY +4.46%), which creates headwind for a long near highs, while the stock's defensive utility nature and strong relative volume (3.86x) suggest the move may already be largely complete. Risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction: chasing long near the high offers minimal upside before the day's high acts as resistance, and shorting a defensive name that has outperformed significantly on a risk-off day carries its own structural risk.
